description: REQ-P7a's per-file table (labeled 実ファイル確認済み, added specifically to close iteration-1's blocking FIND-001) gives wrong line numbers for `self/self-fix.sh`. The table states: 代入span = 67-76 (TASK="..."), 起動行 = 77 (`tmux ... -- "$TASK"`). Live on-disk verification (`awk`/`grep -n` on ~/anicca/skills/self/self-fix.sh, last modified 2026-07-05 -- i.e. unchanged since well before the 2026-07-07 recon, so this is a transcription error, not drift) shows the TASK="..." assignment actually spans lines 67-74 (its closing quote is on line 74, ending '...Report what you fixed + the real evidence at the end."'), the tmux launch line is actually line 75 (not 77), and lines 76-77 are unrelated POST-launch bookkeeping statements (`date +%s > "$STARTMARK"` and a log `echo`) that execute AFTER the spawn has already fired. Independently re-verified the other 7 rows of the same table against their real files and all 7 are accurate (capafy-loop-cli.sh 8/12, reddit-loop-cli.sh 9/13, life-manager-loop-cli.sh 8/12, clip-promote-cli.sh 24/39, video-cli.sh 17/32, clip-cli.sh 18/33, adversary-daily.sh 20-21/23 all confirmed correct) -- this is an isolated error in the self-fix.sh row only, but it is in the single most complex, highest-risk file (the only one with a real multi-line prompt body). PROP-P7a's Tier-0 mechanism computes the mandatory insertion window as 'the line after the assignment span's end through the line before the launch line' using exactly these table numbers. Following the table's (wrong) numbers for self-fix.sh directs an implementer or verify.sh author to treat the window as being between the real STARTMARK-write line and the real log-echo line -- i.e. strictly AFTER the tmux launch has already executed. A promotion line inserted there would never become part of the `$TASK` value actually passed to the spawned `claude` session, silently reproducing exactly the class of bug FIND-001 was raised to prevent (text present in the file, absent from the runtime prompt), specifically in the file with the highest blast radius for that failure mode.
suggestedFix: Correct the self-fix.sh row in REQ-P7a's table to 代入span = 67-74, 起動行 = 75, and re-derive PROP-P7a's self-fix.sh-specific sed range accordingly (insertion window = line 75, i.e. immediately after line 74's closing quote and before the real launch line 75). Re-verify all 8 rows against the actual files one more time before implementation begins (rather than trusting the 2026-07-07 recon's transcription), since this table is now the sole mechanism protecting against FIND-001's failure mode and a single wrong row defeats it silently for that file.
